Find the pre-approved image/video for today's post in your 'Month 1' content folder.
Resize or add any final text overlays; match brand colors and fonts.
Choose correct format: Carousel for multiple images, Reel for vertical video, Single Image for one photo, Story for ephemeral content.
Copy from the Content Calendar tab; paste into Instagram's caption box.
Copy from the Hashtag Library tab; mix 1 main bundle with 1–2 tags from another bundle.
Always tag Wilmington, NC or the specific beach town related to the project.
Tag clients (with permission), local businesses, or team members.
Poll, quiz, countdown, or question sticker for engagement.
Choose a visually striking image that makes people want to tap.
Aim for 7–9am or 6–8pm; match the schedule in your Content Calendar.
Reply to first comments within 15 minutes to boost reach.
Save the post in your 'Published' folder for records.
Log likes, comments, saves, shares, reach, engagement rate in the Analytics tab.
